programme.title: Earth seen from space – New perspectives | S01E01
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. Cameras in space allow you to admire life on Earth from a completely different perspective. You can observe animal migrations, seasonal changes and sea tides. Viewers will follow elephants searching for water, discover new penguin colonies, and look at ice circles that pose a threat to seals. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Earth seen from space – Patterns and patterns | S01E02
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. When the Earth is viewed from space, its surface is covered with multicolored spots and shapes. Modern technology and a completely new perspective will allow you to look at, among others, elephants in the Congo and wombats burrowing in the Australian wilderness. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Earth seen from space – Colorful planet | S01E03
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. Our planet is stunning from space. It shimmers with various colors, e.g. China has a beautiful yellow color coming from rapeseed flowers. The neon lights of the northern lights please the eye with their blue. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Earth seen from space – Planet of changes | S01E04
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. Cameras in space record changes taking place on Earth. Cities are growing rapidly, and the area of ​​forests and glaciers is decreasing alarmingly. The people of Tanzania decided to stop this process. They reclaimed land to save the chimpanzees. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Texas: Alligator Rescue – Dangerous Waters | E02
programme.desc: Gator Country researchers, experts and interns educate viewers about alligators. Their task is to save those predators that have left their habitats and gotten lost. Then they move the animals to a reserve where they can function peacefully... USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 3 – Monster Saw Fish | S03E04
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade travels the world and looks at the strangest, most terrifying fish that inhabit rivers. He talks to people who survived the encounter with water monsters. Jeremy Wade, a fan of extreme fishing, continues his travels around the world in search of the most dangerous freshwater fish. This time it's going to be crazy. USA. 2011. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Vienna
programme.desc: Vienna is one of the most biologically active cities in the world. It is in the capital of Austria that you can see wildlife almost everywhere. The island of Donauinsel, located on the Danube, is designed to protect against flooding and is also a recreational area... Germany. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: The Wild East of Poland
programme.desc: The documentary focuses on one of the last wild regions in Europe, the Biebrza Valley. The largest National Park in Poland is a habitat for beavers, otters and a whole host of water birds... Germany, Poland. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: Forests: mysterious lands – Taiga | E05
programme.desc: The richest and most diverse forests on Earth will be presented. From the tropics to both poles. Viewers will learn how they provide living conditions for animals. Journey to the Arctic. Viewers will see what life is like in the boreal forest. During the expedition, they will learn about the extraordinary abilities of reindeer, visit the tunnels that rodents create in the snow, and discover why moose have refined culinary tastes. Netherlands. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: In the Depths: North America – Dangerous Coasts | S01E05
programme.desc: Filmmakers observe distant corners of the North American continent. In each episode they go to a different part of this land. With a camera, they observe the life of animals from various local ecosystems, from coastal waters to the air. Lizzie faces her biggest challenge yet - diving among bullhead sharks. In the swamps of the Gulf of Mexico there are also hungry alligators, cunning caiman turtles and small but extremely strong beach mice that strengthen the dunes. USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: In the Depths: North America – Changing Tides | S01E06
programme.desc: Filmmakers observe distant corners of the North American continent. In each episode they go to a different part of this land. With a camera, they observe the life of animals from various local ecosystems, from coastal waters to the air. During an expedition in the far and wild North, Lizzie's crew tags sharks. He also observes with concern the slow disappearance of the ice. The filmmakers visit a special prison for polar bears captured while trying to raid the city in search of food. The hunting grounds of these mammals are systematically decreasing, so predators are looking for food in other places. USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: An insightful look at the arms race in the animal world. Thanks to the use of special photographic techniques, the program makers present the world from the perspective of both the predator and the prey. Lions, cheetahs, panthers and other carnivorous animals have to work hard to get food. You must first locate the victim and, before capturing it, use trickery and win the race with it. After all, when a predator catches its desired target, it must make sure that its competitor does not take its prey away... documentary series

programme.title: Animals: Champions of Survival – The Fastest | S01E01
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories. Ranking of animals that can kill their prey the fastest or avoid danger. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: David Attenborough and the mammoth graveyard
programme.desc: Sally and Neville Hollingworth are amateur fossil hunters. Together with David Attenborough and professor of evolutionary biology, Ben Garrod, they are looking for traces of mammoths on the outskirts of the British city of Swindon. According to hypotheses, many individuals of this prehistoric species could have lived here during the Ice Age... Great Britain. 2021. nature film

programme.title: Around the world with David Attenborough – Around the world | E01
programme.desc: When Sir David Attenborough, the British writer, traveler and popularizer of nature knowledge, turned 80, many thought it was the end of his career. However, it turns out that it was quite the opposite. Attenborough made a series of nature films examining the development of life on Earth, from its origins at the bottom of the ocean to the present day. He presents the results of his research in a series of documentary films... Great Britain. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Earth – planet of life – Extraordinary birth | E01
programme.desc: Earth has survived countless collisions and disasters in the solar system. From asteroid impacts to volcanic eruptions and climate crises. The program will show what some of them looked like. Earth only became a habitable planet when it collided with a Mars-sized protoplanet shortly after the formation of the solar system. Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: From a bird's eye view
programme.desc: The majesty, complexity and ecological connections of our planet will be presented. You can only see them all from a bird's eye view... Great Britain. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: Extreme Life – Cold | E01
programme.desc: The series highlights a variety of incredibly resilient life forms that struggle to survive on our increasingly unpredictable planet. Are there limits to adaptation and survival? Episode description: Cold lands are very demanding territories, but also full of opportunities; only the most resilient creatures can survive in an environment where the key to survival is adaptability... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – Perfect Predator | S01E01
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. As a result of evolution, sharks have become natural hunters, perfect predators. They are extremely effective in chasing their prey in open waters and hunting from ambush. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Big cats in a small world – Kittens from the summer litter | E01
programme.desc: The life of the big cats living in the Gomoti River in Botswana is not an easy one. They have to deal with floods as well as intruders. Surviving in this demanding environment forces leopards, lions and cheetahs to use all their skills... Canada. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Wild New Zealand | S01E01
programme.desc: A three-episode documentary revealing the secrets of the flora and fauna of the remote islands of New Zealand, the last land discovered and inhabited by humans. For 80 million years, life went on there in its own strange way. With the arrival of people, new species of animals arrived there, such as merino, ermine, and kakapo, the only flightless species of parrot in the world, found only there. In New Zealand forests you can track down predators from the Jurassic period, meet forest penguins and sheep dogs flying in helicopters. Great Britain. 2016. documentary film

programme.title: 30 for 30: Boo-Yah: A Portrait of Stuart Scott
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/f Time of Giants
programme.desc: In the past two decades, scientists have made stunning discoveries that have greatly expanded our understanding of dinosaur life. This documentary takes us into the world of these giants, showing how they survived and adapted. We explore not only new species of dinosaurs, but also their behavior, survival tactics, and the evolutionary processes that allowed them to thrive for millions of years. France, 2020

programme.title: d/f Wild horses of France
programme.desc: A documentary about the wild horses that live in the Camargue nature reserve in France, which is the crown jewel of European wildlife. In this picturesque location, located between two tributaries of the Rhone that flow into the Mediterranean Sea, you can observe the life of these majestic animals throughout all seasons of the year. The film reveals the beauty and uniqueness of these horses, as well as the peculiarities of their existence in a breathtaking natural environment. USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Sharks. Declaration of love. 2 s.
programme.desc: Sharks are the oldest inhabitants of the ocean, having survived millions of years of evolution and retained their uniqueness to this day. We learn about the different species of sharks, their anatomy, behavior and ecology. programme.title: In the animal world. 45 pp.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/s African stories of the cheetah family. 5 s.
programme.desc: And in East Africa, Matto Barfuss in 2013, north of the Serengeti, came across a cheetah - Maleika. Matto was convinced that she was Diana's great-granddaughter. He decided to share the story of this incredible cheetah with the world. Spain, 2020

programme.title: d/s African stories of the cheetah family. 6 p.
programme.desc: Maleika managed to take down Thomson's young gazelle, despite her weakness. Children, are you ready? We are going to look for new places to hunt. Maleika's weakness is evident to the surrounding animals. Spain, 2020

programme.title: d/f Big cats of the Serengeti
programme.desc: The Serengeti is a region in East Africa that is home to about seventy species of large mammals. The documentary will introduce channel viewers to some of the most notable and interesting inhabitants of these places: lions and cheetahs. The plot centers on several families, each of them daily fighting a difficult struggle for survival in the savannah. Here are just a few real-life wildlife stories that would be the envy of any film writer. Two lion cubs, born during the dry season, find themselves on the brink of starvation because their mother Kali runs out of milk. Desperate to feed her cubs, she finds and eats the carcass of a dead hippopotamus... A lonely male cheetah, Moto, falls in love with Nyota. At first they become friends, and soon start a family. But one day Nyota disappears, and Moto goes in search of her across the endless African plains. Dir.: Jongyul Lee. South Korea, 2019

programme.title: d/f Genetta's Story
programme.desc: Deep in the Mediterranean forest, little genet cubs are just beginning to discover the world around them. One of them, a little predator, decides to take a bold step - to leave her family to go on an independent journey. However, along with the beauty of nature, she will have to face many dangers that await her at every step. Spain, 2016

programme.title: My wild cats. My African cats
programme.desc: Wild cat populations around the world have declined sharply over the past few decades due to habitat loss, poaching and other factors. However, thanks to the creation of protected areas such as national parks and reserves, some species have a chance to survive. 2021, educational

programme.title: d/f Mavindo. The Great Drama of the Serengeti
programme.desc: In the vastness of Africa's Serengeti National Park, animals face constant threats. For them, every day is a struggle for survival, where danger can come at any moment. In the savannah they must be alert to avoid becoming victims of predators or poachers. This film will reveal the exciting and challenging world of the wild, where every moment matters for survival. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2019

programme.title: d/s Wild Thailand. Game of procreation

Like many, Ronaldo started out playing street football, running with friends through the streets of the small seaside town of Funchal in Portugal. Cristiano also played for an amateur team, where his talent was noticed by football selectors. From then on, Ronaldo's rapid rise as a football player began. He changed many famous clubs, became a repeated winner of the Ballon d'Or, won the Champions League and local championships, and finally became the most expensive football player in the world. programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: “Terra Trip to magical worlds.

programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: Floods, snow, fires, sandstorms and extreme temperatures: the grassland inhabitants from Africa to South America to Siberia have to be tough to survive.

programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: Leopards in Mumbai, hyenas in Harar, peregrine falcons in New York, flocks of starlings in Rome: The final part of the “Terra X” series about extreme habitats shows how wild animals have adapted to cities. The cheekiest inhabitants are probably rhesus monkeys, which dominate entire neighborhoods in Jaipur.

programme.title: Deadly Mission Shark – Fixed die Haie
programme.desc: A training session awaits the team at Rainbow Reef. Mentor Steve Backshall then splits the group up to observe blacktip sharks up close. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly Mission Shark – Fixed die Haie
programme.desc: The team splits up for the next tasks: While one group sights young lemon sharks in the mangrove forests of the Bahamas, the rest explore Bimini's tourist area Alice Town. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Jumps over six meters, boxing matches between fellow animals and a bag full of secrets: kangaroos fascinate with their strength, elegance and surprising social behavior in the rough outback of Australia. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Melodic calls, bright plumage and amazing flight skills: from their first hatching to their first flight, birds demonstrate impressive adaptability and behavior. (Station info).

programme.title: Oases of biodiversity
programme.desc: Swamps, mangroves, rainforests: the nature in eastern Australia offers a home to unique plants and animals. The untouched forests give an idea of ​​what the island once looked like. (Station info).

programme.title: Oases of biodiversity
programme.desc: An enormous number of animal species live between the mountains and desert of British Columbia. Among them, one species in particular stands out – the grizzly bear. (Station info).

programme.title: Oases of biodiversity
programme.desc: Costa Rica is one of the most biodiverse regions in the world. Whether in the forests, on the mountain peaks or on the rivers: remarkable wild animals can be found everywhere. (Station info).

programme.title: Oases of biodiversity
programme.desc: The island groups of the Caribbean are home to intact ecosystems that inspire scientists. Because of its isolated location, the Greater Antilles are home to an infinite number of animal species. (Station info).

programme.title: Oases of biodiversity
programme.desc: Wild coasts and dry desert areas characterize Namibia. Despite the barren living conditions, numerous animal species grow and thrive. (Station info).

programme.title: Bears – A terribly nice family
programme.desc: Bears cope with foraging, fighting with rivals and losing their habitat. With strength, brains and amazing adaptability, they ensure the survival of their species. (Station info).

programme.title: Animalically aloof
programme.desc: How do birds, insects, mammals and even snakes overcome gravity? Fascinating insights into the science of flight and the art of survival. (Station info).

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise
programme.desc: Dangerous rivers, ancient forests and fascinating survival strategies: proboscis monkeys, orangutans, sun bears and hornbills fight for survival in the rainforest of Borneo. (Station info).

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise
programme.desc: A lioness hunts oryx in the dunes while elephants search for hidden sources of water. At the same time, ostriches dance around their females and a desert frog lurks for its favorite food: termites. (Station info).

programme.title: The queens of the savannah
programme.desc: When it comes to emancipation, they are at the forefront: elephant cows lead the herd, lionesses are much more combative than their male counterparts, and female baboons team up to raise their babies and teach them social behavior.

programme.title: Small animals on a long journey
programme.desc: A young pangolin fights for survival and hopes to find a mate. A family of golden-headed lion tamarins searches for food in the threatened Atlantic Forest. (Station info).

programme.title: Penguins up close
programme.desc: Rockhopper penguins are excellent jumpers - falls don't bother them much. Meanwhile, Humboldt penguins have figured out how best to survive heat and drought. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Japan – land of a thousand islands
programme.desc: The south of Japan is brimming with harsh natural forces, ocean, volcanoes, typhoons. The remote islands offer a paradise for animals. Incredible symbioses of monkeys and deer can be found here. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild School – orphans in the animal kingdom
Our earth is changing
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmaker Gordon Buchanan visits a jaguar conservation project in the Brazilian Pantanal. In Cambodia, explorer Ella Al-Shamahi experiences first-hand the overexploitation of nature. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: Naturalist Steve Backshall starts his search in Indonesia. There are three possible candidates for his top 60 list here: the Komodo dragon, the flying kite and the pit viper. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: In the Ethiopian city of Harar, Steve gets the chance to hand-feed a pack of spotted hyenas. A little later, in the highlands of East Africa, the naturalist meets the rarest wolf in the world. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: Steve is traveling in the UK. The naturalist comes face to face with the dreaded conger eel off the coast of Plymouth. Back on land, the next killer is waiting for him: the dragonfly. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: Steve locates a humpback whale off the coast of Alaska. The naturalist intensively studies their hunting techniques before going on land to search for grizzly bears. (Station info).

programme.title: The great migrations of animals
programme.desc: Every year the north of Kenya experiences a spectacle like no other: 1000 elephants meet. With the help of satellites, scientists are able to follow their dangerous migration. (Station info).

programme.title: Fascination Africa
programme.desc: 80,000 Lechwe antelopes live in the Okavango Delta, where the first of the series takes you. Every year, rainwater from Angola floods the world's largest inland delta at 20,000 km², creating a paradisiacal habitat until the long dry season.

programme.title: Seals' Playground - The Wild Coast of Brittany
programme.desc: Seals and gray seals live in harsh conditions on the coast of Brittany. Strong tides, predators and territorial battles characterize their everyday lives - especially during mating season. (Station info).

programme.desc: Trước khi có giấy vệ sinh, người Mỹ gần như sử dụng bất cứ thứ gì - cho đến khi anh em nhà Scott biến sai lầm thành cơ hội và phát minh ra cuộn giấy vệ sinh, khai sinh ra một ngành công nghiệp trị giá hàng tỷ đô la mới.

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S15 EP223
programme.desc: Tác động của thiên thạch đã làm thay đổi thế giới của chúng ta, tạo ra môi trường hoàn hảo cho sự phát triển của loài người. Nhưng liệu bằng chứng mới có thể tiết lộ rằng các thiên thể đã được trí thông minh ngoài hành tinh hướng tới Trái đất?

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP38
programme.desc: Thế giới có rất nhiều hiện tượng tự nhiên kỳ lạ đến mức thách thức sự hiểu biết thông thường. Khoa học có thể giải thích những bí ẩn của Trái đất? Hay kiến ​​thức của con người về Trái đất chỉ ở phần bề mặt?

programme.title: VÕ LÂM TRUY SÁT - WU LIN: THE SOCIETY
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 2050, nơi tình trạng ô nhiễm và virus tràn lan buộc mọi người phải đeo khẩu trang chỉ để thở, tuy nhiên cuộc sống hàng ngày vẫn tiếp tục như thường lệ. Khi hàng loạt cái chết bí ẩn nổ ra, cảnh sát nghi ngờ kẻ giết người hàng loạt trong khi có tin đồn về một con quỷ đang nổi cơn thịnh nộ. Giờ đây, cảnh sát phải chạy đua để làm sáng tỏ bí ẩn và ngăn chặn các vụ giết người trước khi sự hoảng loạn bao trùm thành phố.

programme.title: TAY ĐẤM HUYỀN THOẠI - FIST OF LEGEND
programme.desc: Khi Chen Zhen học ở Nhật Bản, anh phát hiện một số sinh viên Trung Quốc mất tích và vô tình phát hiện ra âm mưu của Hội Rồng Đen. Một loại thuốc mới được phát minh để tăng cường sức khỏe cho quân đội Nhật Bản trong chiến tranh và các sinh viên Trung Quốc được sử dụng trong thí nghiệm của họ. Chen Zhen thề sẽ tiêu diệt tổ chức tà ác và phá hủy phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của chúng.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM NGHĨA TÌNH - LOVE PUNCH
programme.desc: Võ sĩ tài năng Jia Yang bị vướng vào một cuộc chiến ngầm để trả nợ cho cha cô. Cô đánh mất khát vọng Olympic và biến mất khỏi thế giới quyền anh. 10 năm sau, huấn luyện viên Li Yue quyết tâm giúp cô thực hiện tâm nguyện của cha mình bằng cách trở lại sàn đấu. Khi niềm đam mê và nghĩa vụ va chạm, liệu Jia Yang có thể vực dậy giấc mơ quyền anh bị bỏ rơi của mình không?

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người đang làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời dùng thử sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.desc: Cựu quân nhân Wu và cảnh sát chìm Ming giải cứu con tin trên một hòn đảo gần Bangkok. Ngay khi nhiệm vụ hoàn thành và họ chuẩn bị rời đi, Wu phát hiện ra con gái mình cũng đã bị bắt. Quyết tâm cứu cô, anh ở lại cùng Ming để chiến đấu với bọn côn đồ và giải cứu cô.
